impact_scope.description: A new public experimental function filters degenerate and duplicate triangles from an index buffer.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration or implementation of meshopt_filterIndexBuffer, so this newly anchored API had no pre-change exposure obligation.
S1 declares and implements meshopt_filterIndexBuffer as a new public experimental callable.
H0 never calls meshopt_filterIndexBuffer; its existing index-generation and simplification calls do not automatically reach this new entry point.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a direct meshopt_filterIndexBuffer call with destination storage, triangle indices, vertex data, vertex count, vertex size, and vertex stride to expose the new API.
evidence: The new API requires an explicit caller invocation and its caller-supplied buffers and size/stride parameters.
No existing H0 call is a one-hop caller that invokes meshopt_filterIndexBuffer automatically.

reason: The principal unit is the newly introduced public meshopt_filterIndexBuffer entry point. It did not exist in S0, making Gap(S0,H0) false for this exact unit; it exists but is uncalled in S1, making Gap(S1,H0) true. The false-to-true transition is NEW and therefore requires harness maintenance.
